user.title: Create a family tree and root person
user.description: When the database is empty, this form also creates the first person as the Level 1 root. Existing people are restored automatically from `/config/cay_gia_pha/`.

data_description.tree_name: The name shown for this family tree in Home Assistant.
data_description.full_name: The first person is created during integration setup and becomes the Level 1 root.
data_description.birth_year: Optional. Select from the list or type a year directly.
data_description.birth_month: Optional. A month can be stored without a known year.
data_description.birth_day: Optional. A day can be stored without a complete month and year.
data_description.is_deceased: Enable for a deceased person. A death date is not required.
data_description.death_year: Optional even when deceased. A year alone can be stored.
data_description.death_month: Optional. Select or type the death month independently.
data_description.death_day: Optional. Select or type the death day independently.
data_description.image_upload: JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF; maximum 15 MB. The image is stored locally in Home Assistant.
data_description.sort_order: A secondary value used to keep layout order stable.
data_description.details: Biography, hometown, notes, or other information.
data_description.gender: Select a gender so the integration can filter spouse choices and determine father or mother roles correctly.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one family tree is supported per Home Assistant instance.
abort.already_configured: The family tree is already configured.
abort.unsupported_home_assistant_version: This integration requires Home Assistant 2025.4.0 or newer because it uses config subentries.

error.invalid_partial_date: The entered year, month, or day is invalid. Unknown parts may be left empty.
error.date_in_future: This date or year cannot be in the future.
error.death_before_birth: The known death information is earlier than the known birth information.
error.unsupported_image_type: This image format is not supported.
error.image_too_large: The image exceeds the 15 MB limit.
error.image_save_failed: The image could not be saved to the data directory.

user.title: Add person · Personal information

data_description.birth_year: Optional. Select quickly or type a custom year; year-only dates are supported.
data_description.birth_month: Optional and may be stored without a year.
data_description.birth_day: Optional and may be stored without a complete month and year.
data_description.is_deceased: A death year, month, and day may all remain empty.
data_description.death_year: Optional. A death year alone is enough for year-based age calculation.
data_description.death_month: Optional and may be selected or typed independently.
data_description.death_day: Optional and may be selected or typed independently.
data_description.image_upload: JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF; maximum 15 MB. The selected image is previewed directly below this field.
data_description.details: Biography, hometown, notes, or other information.
data_description.full_name: Enter the full name shown on the family tree and used for the person entity name.
data_description.gender: Used for person colors and spouse filtering: male can select only female and female can select only male.

relationships.title: Add person · Family relationships

data_description.father_id: May be left empty when the father is unknown. Open the field and type a name to search.
data_description.mother_id: May be left empty when the mother is unknown. Open the field and type a name to search.
data_description.spouse_id: For a female person: select one male husband. Open the field and type a name to search.
data_description.sibling_ids: Select multiple people and type to search. The integration also detects siblings sharing the same parents.
data_description.birth_order: Birth order 1 is placed furthest left, followed by younger siblings, regardless of gender.
data_description.is_adopted: Select parents normally; the card adds an Adopted label and a dashed parent line.
data_description.level: Leave at 0 to calculate from parents, spouse, or siblings.
data_description.sort_order: Used only when birth order and birth date are the same.
data_description.spouse_ids: For a male person: select multiple female wives and type a name to search. Select them in First wife, Wife 2, Wife 3 order; the exact position can also be set in each wife profile.
data_description.spouse_order: For a female person. Use 1 for the first wife, 2 for Wife 2, and so on. Wives of the same husband must use different positions.
